amharic: የልጅነቴን ጊዚያት በጣም ወደዋለሁ። ምክንያቱም ከጎረቤት ልጆች ጋር በጣም እየተጫወትን ነበር ያደግነው። እንደውም በሰፈራችን ቴሌቪዥን ስላልነበረ አንደ ቤት ነበረ የነበረው እና ሁሌም የገመና ድራማ ተሰብስበን አንድ ላይ እናይ ነበረ። እናም ከዛ በኋላ ስለድራማው እህተን ደግሞ እንነጋገር ነበር። በደንብ እንጫወት ነበር። እና ልጅነቴን በደንብ አድርጌ የማሳልፌ እንዳይቆጨኝ አደርገኛል። አሁን ልጅነቴን ሳስብ ደስ ይለኛል እንጂ አዘዝዘብበትም እና ከዚህ የተነሳ ልጆች በደንብ መጫወት እንዳለባችሁ ተምሬያለሁ። ምክንያቱም በመጫወቱ ልጆች እና በማጫወቱ ልጆች መካከል ትልቅ ልዩነት አለ። ተጫውተው ያላደጉ ልጆች ከሰው ጋር መግባባት ይከብዳቸዋል። ስለዚህ ልጆች መጫወት እንዳለባቸው ተረድቻለሁ።
english: I love my childhood. Because we grew up playing a lot with the neighbor's children. Actually, since there was no television in our neighborhood, there was one house that had it, and we would all gather and watch the 'Gemena' drama together. And then after that, we would talk about the drama. We used to play very well. And this makes me not regret living my childhood well. When I think about my childhood now, I'm happy rather than sad, and because of this, I've learned that children should play well. Because there is a big difference between children who play and children who play. Children who didn't play and grow up find it difficult to get along with people. So I've understood that children need to play.
moments: The speaker loves their childhood because of playing with neighbors.
They used to gather at the only house with a TV in the neighborhood to watch 'Gemena'.
They enjoyed discussing the drama and playing games together.
The speaker has no regrets and is happy looking back at their childhood.
They learned that childhood play is crucial for social development.
